sheet.title: Start with a diamond
sheet.instruction: Set a square green side up, with one corner pointing toward you.
sheet.result: A flat green square stands on one corner.

mark-center.title: Mark the centerline
mark-center.instruction: Bring the right corner over to the left corner. Press the long vertical fold.
mark-center.result: A gold triangle lies to the left of the centerline.

open-center.title: Open the vertical fold
open-center.instruction: Swing the same corner back to the right. Keep the diamond facing you.
open-center.result: The square is open with a vertical crease.

mark-across.title: Find the middle
mark-across.instruction: Bring the top corner down to the bottom corner. Press along the horizontal fold.
mark-across.result: A gold triangle points toward you.

open-across.title: Open the diamond
open-across.instruction: Lift the top layer back up. Find the crossing of the two creases.
open-across.result: The open green diamond has two creases crossing at its center.

top-to-center.title: Bring the top to the center
top-to-center.instruction: Fold the top corner down until its point touches the crossing.
top-to-center.result: A small gold triangle sits below a short horizontal top edge.

bottom-to-top.title: Raise the bottom point
bottom-to-top.instruction: Bring the bottom corner up to the middle of the short top edge. Press the new lower edge flat.
bottom-to-top.result: A broad gold flap covers the middle of the packet.

lift-left.title: Lift the left half
lift-left.instruction: Hold the midpoint of the lower edge. Swing its left end up with every layer until that half of the edge lies on the vertical centerline.
lift-left.result: The old left corner points up, forming the first lobe.

lift-right.title: Lift the right half
lift-right.instruction: Swing the right end of the lower edge up to meet its partner on the centerline.
lift-right.result: Two high points frame a V above a single lower tip.

soften-left.title: Turn the left side behind
soften-left.instruction: Lift the heart clear of the table. Bend the outermost left point behind the stack on the short vertical guide.
soften-left.result: The left side has a short straight edge.

soften-right.title: Match the right side
soften-right.instruction: Bend the right side point behind by the same amount.
soften-right.result: The two sides have matching flat edges.

left-lobe.title: Shape the left lobe
left-lobe.instruction: Bend the very top of the left point behind, keeping its crease parallel to the top edge of the original flap.
left-lobe.result: The left lobe has a short level top and the center notch stays open.

right-lobe.title: Finish the heart
right-lobe.instruction: Fold the right tip behind at the same height as the left. Press both little folds flat.
right-lobe.result: Your paper heart has two broad lobes, a V-shaped notch and a sharp lower point.
